course_name_en: Manufacturing Processes for Pharmaceutical Dosage Forms

learning_outcomes.text: Define the characteristics of pharmaceutical dosage forms.
Assign quality requirements to the respective dosage form.
Describe the technology and process flow of the corresponding manufacturing process, including critical process steps and parameters.
Recognize typical production errors, perform error analysis, and identify the causative process parameters.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of different manufacturing processes for a dosage form and propose a suitable manufacturing route adapted to the problem.
Understand the role of pharmaceutical technology in the development of new drugs.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to different dosage forms and their manufacturing processes, especially:
Handling of highly potent active pharmaceutical ingredients
Formulations for poorly soluble active pharmaceutical ingredients
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grading is weighted by credit points.
